name: Bhagavad Gita 4.7
group: The Gita on duty and offering
text:
यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भवति भारत ।
अभ्युत्थानमधर्मस्य तदात्मानं सृजाम्यहम् ॥
meaning: Whenever balance and righteousness decline and destructive forces rise, I manifest to restore balance.
purpose: A verse about restoring order and responding when values are threatened.
supports: Moral courage; responsibility; hope; acting in line with one’s values.
when: When reflecting on a difficult situation or the need to act responsibly.
